## Summary

**Rollback:** ✅ Complete
- **v2.3.1** (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate.
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and also unhealthy).
- First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after rolling back us-east only). Retried the rollback, which completed successfully.
- **Current state:** all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) on **v2.3.0**, healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident:** ✅ Opened
- The incident creation API call initially timed out, but I verified it was actually created before retrying to avoid duplicates — no duplicate was made.
- **INC-0001** (SEV2) is open for checkout-api, documenting the health-check failures, the partial-failure + retry during rollback, and the final recovered state.

**Follow-up recommendation:** v2.3.1 should be investigated before any re-deploy, and the orchestrator partial-failure during rollback may warrant a look as well.
